تستقربي (form X)
# تَسْتَقْرِبِي (tastaqribī) /tas.taq.ri.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْرَبَ (istaqraba)
# تُسْتَقْرَبِي (tustaqrabī) /tus.taq.ra.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْرَبَ (istaqraba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
